ogre-system-info
================

.. tip:: Ingestion into Splunk.

   **``windows:ogre:system_info``**

   * name_rex: ``\.jsonl$``
   * path_suffix: ``ogre-system-info``
   * sourcetype: ``windows:ogre:system_info``
   * host_rex: ``([\w\.-]+)--``
   * artifact: ``system-info``

-----------

Parsing of systeminfo - using ANSSI DFIR OGRE
